programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Poulenstein, monstre-poulet rejeté, gagne la confiance du poulailler grâce à sa soupe d'orties. Quand il perd un boulon, il devient fou, mais Carmen et Carmélito le réparent. Heureux, il est enfin accepté. Pendant ce temps, Hercule, manipulé par Rattila, capture Carmen et Carmélito, mais Bélino et Hercule sauvent la situation en chassant les rats.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Frou-Frou montre comment faire du parfum avec des pétales dans de l'eau salée. Lulu organise une grande cueillette, mais les abeilles de la nouvelle ruche de Brico ne l'entendent pas de cette oreille. Plus tard, Lulu et Rien-Ne-Sert jouent avec le vent, mais quand une bourrasque arrive, Ni Oui, en aidant Lulu, se retrouve coincé en haut d'un arbre !

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Quelqu'un a commandé une armoire à Mr Hippo… puis a disparu ! Arnaque ? Sherlock enquête. De son côté, Hermine offre un portable à Sherlock, qui galère avec la technologie. Pendant ce temps, Cigogne, experte en savoir-vivre, est ridiculisée en direct à la télé. Phacochère, Grizzli ou Pélican ? Les suspects sont tous de sacrés malpolis !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Bagou s'entraîne, Grabouillon se moque, alors un défi de course est lancé. Épuisé par l'entraînement de Cunégonde, Grabouillon arrive fatigué au départ. Gonzague montre ses appeaux, Grabouillon en vole un et regrette vite. Inspiré par Tarzan, il cherche sa Jane, Cunégonde, tandis qu'après avoir mangé une baie, il devient l'icône mode de l'île !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Pour un fragment de miroir, Marcus participe aux jeux des Bongos, où la rivalité monte entre lui, Ephi, Gratrok et Loumie. Leur amitié tiendra-t-elle ? Plus tard, ils cherchent le fragment au cœur de la forêt Namou. Marcus adopte un chaton semblable à Maurice, mais ce sont en fait des créatures maléfiques au service de Vipkrad. Marcus devra-t-il s'en séparer ?

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Pris pour un gibier par Davy Crockett, Coda se retrouve soldat au fort ! À Versailles, présenté comme un exotique, il s'évade et découvre la vie de cour. Son hologramme guide malgré lui une bergère contre les Anglais. En Écosse, après avoir brillé aux Highland Games, Coda fait exploser un pub… et réveille un fantôme très fâché !

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu se retrouve responsable de la classe. Enseigner et avoir de l'autorité sans être un tyran, ce n'est pas facile...Les amis se fâchent suite à une dispute au sujet de leurs petits défauts. Du coup, le match de hockey qu'ils devaient disputer est annulé. Lulu va tenter de réconcilier tout le monde et de faire accepter à chacun ses petits défauts... y compris à elle !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon participe à un concours photo hilarant, mais il est lui-même peu photogénique. Pétunia lui apprend à nager, mais il galère avec bouées et brassards. Inspiré par la ruée vers l'or, il cherche des pépites dans la rivière, lançant une compétition avec Bagou. Ce dernier pêche, mais Grabouillon gâche tout, provoquant la colère de Bagou.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Le Paon, narcissique, se fait défigurer en se faisant couper ses plumes. Qui ? La Grue, Mme Hippopotame ou la Mouffette ? Pendant ce temps, Sherlock veut suivre la finale de cricket mais doit enquêter. Mme Hippopotame découvre son dentifrice remplacé par du gel moussant. Sherlock déteste les rumeurs, mais Hermine en lance une sur lui !

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: À Halloween, des bonbons aliens transforment trois enfants en monstres qui traquent Coda. Plus tard, il rejoint un groupe de musiciens… les Beatles ? Dans la savane, il sauve un éléphanteau casse-cou, puis remplace un livreur de pizzas au Brésil et finit, malgré lui, au beau milieu d'un match de Coupe du Monde. La routine, quoi !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon casse le miroir de Pétunia, qui lui prédit 7 ans de malheur. Malchance et catastrophes s'enchaînent, mais ce n'est qu'une superstition. Puis, lors d'un goûter les assiettes s'envolent à cause du vent et un pigeon s'en sert comme planche de surf. Enfin, Grabouillon évite le dessert en fuyant et doit ranger la chambre. Dernier défi : remettre une pendule tombée avant l'arrivée de maman.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Un papillon en plein hiver ? Impossible ! A moins que ce soit un papillon extra-terrestre qui transforme ceux qui le touchent en papillon à leur tour. Horreur, Blaise l'a touché !Lulu et la coquetterie, ça fait deux. Mais peut-être qu'avec un peu d'entraînement...

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Basile gronde Grabouillon et Bagout pour un avion en papier avec un dessin. Grabouillon construit un avion géant et vole. Une pièce de puzzle disparue, une horloge cassée, et un coucou volé causent des soucis. Grabouillon casse la tirelire de Pétunia, qui mène l'enquête. La nuit, Hercule, le nain de jardin, s'anime !

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Ce qui au départ semblait être une tâche pénible, enregistrer une vidéo pour le concours de talents organisé par l'école, a finalement transformé Carly Shay et sa meilleure amie Samantha en de véritables stars du web.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Ce qui au départ semblait être une tâche pénible, enregistrer une vidéo pour le concours de talents organisé par l'école, a finalement transformé Carly Shay et sa meilleure amie Samantha en de véritables stars du web.

programme.title: Un crime peut en cacher un autre
programme.desc: Quatre amis, pour aider l'un d'entre eux à faire disparaître le corps d'un policier tué en légitime défense, se retrouvent impliqués dans une histoire aux limites de la fantaisie, perdant le contrôle des événements et finissant dans un cauchemar où rien ni personne n'est ce qui apparaît.

programme.title: Le Combattant
programme.desc: Jem Belcher est né dans la pauvreté, élevé par son grand-père, un ancien boxeur. Désespérant de gagner sa vie et d'honorer l'héritage de son grand-père, il cherche un mentor auprès d'un entraîneur renommé, qui l'entraîne à devenir le plus grand combattant du monde. Inspiré d'une histoire vraie.

programme.title: Gaia
programme.desc: Dans les profondeurs d'une forêt primaire, une forme de vie fantastique s'est développée. Celle-ci, plus ancienne que l'humanité semble être aussi la plus grande découverte de tous les temps.

programme.title: Young Adam
programme.desc: A Glasgow, au début des années 50, Joe est engagé par Les pour travailler sur sa péniche. Un après-midi, les deux hommes découvrent le cadavre d'une jeune femme flottant sur l'eau. Accident ? Suicide ? Meurtre ?

programme.title: Le Grand homme
programme.desc: Détachés en Afghanistan pour 6 mois, les légionnaires Markov et Hamilton sont pris en embuscade lors d'une expédition non autorisée par leur hiérarchie.

programme.title: Poursuite Mortelle
programme.desc: Un groupe de cinq alpinistes fait de la randonnée et de l'escalade dans les Highlands écossais lorsqu'il découvre une jeune fille serbe enterrée dans une petite chambre en pleine nature. Ils se retrouvent alors pris dans un terrifiant jeu du chat et de la souris avec les ravisseurs, alors qu'ils tentent de mettre la jeune fille à l'abri.

programme.title: Hannah mangold
programme.desc: Hannah est suspendue de ses fonctions et trie les dossiers dans les archives du Bureau. Elle n'a pas eu d'hallucination depuis un certain temps et se croit presque en bonne santé. Lucy, quant à elle, a une noix dure à casser : un couple de Berlin a disparu dans les vastes forêts de l'Uckermark. Ils sont venus d'une fête médiévale, ont traversé un village en voiture, puis se sont perdus de vue. Bien qu'Ulf Habermann lui ait fait comprendre à plusieurs reprises qu'elle devait laisser l'affaire à ses collègues du Brandebourg, Lucy se consacre à la recherche de ces deux personnes par intérêt personnel.

programme.title: Une mariée en cavale
programme.desc: Juste avant son mariage, Lisa plaque son fiancé infidèle, Max, et prend le bus direction l'aéroport pour quitter l'Afrique. Le destin veut que son ancien amoureux, Vic, venu ici elle cinq ans plus tôt, voyage dans ce même bus. Il convoie incognito le Nuage d'Anamanga, un diamant légendaire. Mais le car est attaqué et la pierre tant convoitée est dérobée. Menottés l'un à l'autre, Lisa et Vic prennent la fuite dans la jungle...

programme.title: Regardez Un Noël royal en ligne
programme.desc: Kristin Cooper, la jolie et talentueuse assistante d'une société internationale de relations publiques, doit organiser le défilé de mode annuel de Noël et de la vente aux enchères pour l'entrepreneur en vêtements, M. Carson.

programme.title: Christmas Bounty
programme.desc: Une institutrice de New York est menacée par un homme qu'elle a capturé il y a 6 ans alors qu'elle était chasseuse de primes. Ayant gardé son passé secret, elle retourne chez ses parents dans le New Jersey pour l'attraper à nouveau.

programme.title: Santa Who?
programme.desc: Dans ce récit de Noël réconfortant, le vrai père Noël (Leslie Nielsen) tombe de son traîneau et développe l'amnésie. Il tombe rapidement sur un journaliste de télévision blasé qui est son seul espoir de retrouver sa mémoire à temps pour sauver ses vacances.

programme.title: Deux Cupidons Pour Noel
programme.desc: Holly enseigne la littérature et cherche le grand amour. Elle rencontre Josh, un bel avocat, qui peine à la séduire. Josh engage son ami David, lui aussi professeur de littérature, pour écrire des poèmes à Holly à sa place.

programme.title: Un Noël au cœur tendre
programme.desc: Lorsque son petit ami annule leurs projets de vacances, Sadie décide de rentrer dans sa ville natale pour passer Noël avec ses parents. Elle découvre que ces derniers ont vendu l'entreprise familiale, une chocolaterie.

programme.title: Force of execution
programme.desc: Un ténor du crime se retrouve face à un dilemme : continuer à accroître sa richesse ou arrêter ses activités souterraines pour reprendre une vie normale. Mais pendant ce temps, un nouveau criminel débarque en ville avec la ferme intention de le vaincre…

programme.title: Captive
programme.desc: Thérèse Bourgoine, humanitaire en Palawan, est kidnappée avec des touristes par des terroristes musulmans qui militent pour l'indépendance de Mindanao.

programme.title: Le projet Atticus
programme.desc: Fondé en 1976 par le Dr Henry West, l'Institut Atticus étudiait des capacités paranormales : parapsychologie, voyance... Des centaines de cas ont été étudiés, mais rien ne préparait l'équipe à Judith.

programme.title: Speed driver
programme.desc: Eun-ha utilise ses talents de conductrice hors pair dans son métier de livreuse spécialisée dans le transport de criminels et de fugitifs. Un jour, une de ses missions tourne mal.

programme.title: Fard
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, le monde semble fonctionner de façon efficace et contrôlée...

programme.title: A/K
programme.desc: A/K c'est l'histoire de Kim et Anouk qui attendent un bus qui n'arrivera jamais. Pour passer le temps, elles inventent une histoire, celle de Ted « le flic cowboy » et de « Joe le solitaire ». Alors que leurs aventures s'enchaînent au rythme de la folle imagination des deux filles, la voiture de police de Ted s'arrête devant leur abris bus.

programme.title: La peur du vide
programme.desc: Simone est une vieille dame isolée, dont le quotidien est rythmé par un étrange tas de détritus, si imposant dans son petit appartement qu'il l'empêche de vivre normalement. Un jour, Simone se risque à y toucher...

programme.title: Chienne d'histoire
programme.desc: Constantinople 1910. Trop de chiens errants dans les rues de la ville. Le gouvernement en place cherche le moyen de s'en débarrasser avant de décider de déporter 30 000 chiens sur une île déserte au large de la ville.

programme.title: Faites l'amour !
programme.desc: Vincent et Margot, deux acteurs, doivent tourner une scène d'amour. Mais la frontière entre le jeu et la réalité est mince, au moins autant que celle entre l'amour et la haine. À eux d'en faire l'expérience.

programme.title: Denis et les zombies
programme.desc: Mathias emmène ses camarades tourner un film de zombies dans la maison de campagne familiale. Mais les autochtones ne voient pas le tournage d'un très bon œil et Denis, l'ami d'enfance de Mathias, va se révéler de plus en plus collant.

programme.title: Bootyful
programme.desc: Estelle ne s'attendait pas à rencontrer Sacha ce samedi soir. Travesti et libéré, ce dernier va faire voler en éclats ses idées très arrêtées sur la danse, la séduction, l'amour...

programme.title: L'échappée
programme.desc: Alice chante, se maquille et rigole toute seule. Elle est heureuse. Pourtant elle est à l'hôpital, et vient de se faire opérer. Elle est très malade et totalement chauve. Mais elle est amoureuse de son chirurgien. Il l'a sauvée et vient la voir tous les soirs dans sa chambre. Ses visites sont pour Alice un moment magique qui lui permettent d'oublier son insupportable situation. Alice s'échappe dans son imaginaire et se réinvente une vie plus douce et pleine d'amour…

programme.title: Johnno's Dead
programme.desc: Passer 12 ans derrière les barreaux pour un crime que vous n'avez pas commis, ça fait cogiter. Tout devient clair comme l'eau de roche. L'injustice empoisonne l'esprit, et il ne reste plus que de vieux comptes à régler.

programme.title: Brexicuted
programme.desc: Ce film d'animation satirique dépeint les causes du Brexit. Un groupe de personnages anglais, interrogés au lendemain du vote pour la sortie du Royaume-Uni de l'Union européenne, parlent de ce qui a motivé leur décision.

programme.title: Bavure
programme.desc: Au commencement était la tache. Un coup de pinceau fait surgir un être de la gouache, l'ouvre, le transforme, le tord, le complète. De cette évolution en accéléré nait un être conquérant…

programme.title: Le club
programme.desc: Maryse, 75 ans, découvre l'existence du didgeridoo lors d'une activité de groupe de sa maison de retraite animée par un certain Charlie. Emoustillée par cette rencontre, elle entraîne sa copine octogénaire Fabienne dans sa quête de vibrations.

programme.title: Accouchement sonique
programme.desc: Suite à un accident, Serge tombe dans le coma. Une équipe de chercheurs va tenter de stimuler sa mémoire afin de le ramener à la conscience. Serge va alors être confronté à une sorte de rêve lucide, au cours duquel il devra finalement choisir entre la vie et la mort.

programme.title: Service de nettoyage
programme.desc: C'est le matin dans une maison très chic. Jessica, jeune femme de ménage, intervient pour nettoyer les restes de la soirée de la veille. Elle va faire connaissance avec les trois fêtards encore sur place… La rencontre va très vite déraper…

programme.title: Ordalie
programme.desc: À l'heure du thé, on sonne à la porte de M. Kaplan. Le cinquantenaire se trouve nez à nez avec un jeune homme qu'il ne connaît pas, une visite qu'il n'attendait plus.

programme.title: Mort ou fisc
programme.desc: André Boulet, chef d'entreprise dans le secteur de la démolition, souffre d'une grave maladie hallucinatoire. Apprenant que son entreprise va subir un contrôle fiscal, il est pris de panique et décide d'éliminer l'argent du fisc en charge du dossier.

programme.title: Océan
programme.desc: A travers le regard de Jean, un enfant d'une petite dizaine d'années, nous partageons le quotidien d'une famille en vacances à l'océan, à la fin des années 70. Cet été là, Jean réalise que son père et sa mère ne s'aiment plus.

programme.title: Marzevan
programme.desc: Aux derniers jours de sa vie, une vieille dame à la mémoire troublée entrevoit l'histoire de ses origines. Commence alors un voyage vers la terre ancestrale, où les souvenirs et l'imagination s'organisent peu à peu.

programme.title: La bifle
programme.desc: Francis est le patron d'un vidéoclub qui doit son succès aux films de Ti-Kong, star de kung-fu et briseur de nuques. Complexé par la taille de son sexe, Francis n'arrive pas à avouer ses sentiments à Sonia, son employée. Mais lorsqu'elle se voit offrir un rôle dans Evil Nurse, dernier opus de Ti-Kong, Francis n'a plus le choix. Il va devoir regagner sa confiance sexuelle pour sauver Sonia d'un terrible danger : La Bifle.

programme.title: Quelques secondes
programme.desc: Le quotidien de 5 jeunes filles qui vivent dans un Centre d'Hebergement et de Réinsertion Sociale de Paris. Toutes hantées par un passé chargé (viol, abandon, violences), elles tentent d'avancer et préfèrent voir le verre à moitié à plein. Toutes sauf Sam.

programme.title: Meninas Formicida
programme.desc: Dans une petite ville du Brésil, une adolescente passe ses journées à travailler dans une forêt d'eucalyptus où elle chasse des fourmis parasites à l'aide de pesticides. Mais son véritable combat est intérieur.

programme.title: Je criais contre la vie, ou pour elle
programme.desc: Dans une forêt, un troupeau de cerfs se retourne contre la meute de chiens qui le poursuivait jusque là. De cette étrange course naissent des paysages s'élevant du sol.

programme.title: Trois petits points
programme.desc: Une petite couturière attend son mari parti à la guerre.

programme.title: Rhapsodie pour un pot-au-feu
programme.desc: Trois générations d'une même famille cohabitent sous le même toit dans une chorégraphie désaccordée. La mère, chef d'orchestre de la famille, tente en vain de les réunir à table pour le dîner.

programme.title: Floating in my mind
programme.desc: Un film qui raconte l'histoire de la vie, de rencontres, de souvenirs...

programme.title: Le dernier jour d'un condamné
programme.desc: Camille, une jeune lycéenne, est en pleines révisions. Lassée par son travail, Camille jette un œil dans le frigidaire et y trouve un homard vivant. Se prenant d'affection pour l'animal, l'adolescente décide de lui faire vivre les plus belles heures de son existence...

programme.title: A Shadow of blue
programme.desc: Un soir d'automne, dans un parc situé au milieu d'une ville morne, une petite fille assise sur un banc, nous fait partager plusieurs visions d'une même réalité.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Tempête De Neige
programme.desc: Barbara et Liz, amies d'enfance, se retrouvent à l'âge de trente ans. Barbara apprend que Liz a été mariée à un voyou, aujourd'hui en liberté conditionnelle. Cette dernière lui confie son intention de quitter la ville.

programme.title: La saison des Requins
programme.desc: Trois kayakistes luttent pour leur vie lorsqu'un grand requin blanc les piège sur une petite île en train de sombrer.

programme.title: 2 Lava 2 Lantula!
programme.desc: Colton West reprend du service afin de mettre hors d'état de nuire les Lavalantulas.

programme.title: After Life
programme.desc: Dans un endroit mystérieux, les morts doivent mettre en scène un film revenant sur le temps le plus fort de leur vie passée.

programme.title: Paradise Lost
programme.desc: Des jeunes touristes américains prennent du bon temps au Brésil à l'occasion de leurs vacances. La détente tourne court lorsque leur bus est pris dans un accident... Ils doivent alors trouver rapidement un refuge. Ils atteignent une plage paradisiaque mais ils se font dépouiller pendant la nuit ! De nouveaux évènements étranges et très inquiétants commencent à se produire et les membres du groupe réalisent que leurs vies sont en très grand danger...

programme.title: The Brass Teapot
programme.desc: Un jeune couple découvre une théière magique qui fait apparaître de l'argent à chaque fois que quelqu'un souffre à ses côtés. Mais le douloureux objet attire bien des convoitises...

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: Goldmoon, une société écran qui abrite un syndicat du crime, vient de perdre son président et parrain. La succession est proche, et trois hommes vont livrer bataille pour accéder au trOne. Parmi eux, un flic infiltré depuis 10 ans veut profiter de ce changement pour sortir du syndicat et reprendre une vie normale. Mais comme la police a encore besoin de ses services et que ses concurrents au trOne mènent une enquête sur une potentielle taupe, il va devoir faire un choix: rester dans l'organisation criminelle, ou en sortir.

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Professeur d'économie dans une université du Connecticut, Walter Vale, la soixantaine, a perdu son goût pour l'enseignement et mène désormais une vie routinière. Il tente de combler le vide de son existence en apprenant le piano, mais sans grand succès. Lorsque l'université l'envoie à Manhattan pour assister à une conférence, Walter constate qu'un jeune couple s'est installé dans son appartement : victimes d'une escroquerie immobilière, Tarek, d'origine syrienne, et sa petite amie sénégalaise Zainab n'ont nulle part ailleurs où aller. D'abord un rien réticent, Walter accepte de laisser les deux jeunes gens habiter chez lui. Touché par sa gentillesse, Tarek, musicien doué, insiste pour apprendre au vieux professeur à jouer du tambour africain. Peu à peu, Walter retrouve une certaine joie de vivre et découvre le milieu des clubs de jazz et des passionnés de musique. Et tandis que les deux hommes deviennent amis, les différences d'âge, de culture et de caractère s'estompent. Mais lorsque Tarek, immigré clandestin, est arrêté par la police dans le métro, il est menacé de reconduite à la frontière. Walter n'a alors d'autre choix que de tout mettre en oeuvre pour venir en aide à son ami.

programme.title: Slice
programme.desc: Bangkok est le théâtre d'une série de meurtres épouvantables, dont les victimes démembrées et découpées sont à chaque fois retrouvées dans des valises rouges. L'enquête de l'inspecteur Chin est au point mort et la police reste impuissante. Elle fait alors appel à Tai, un ancien tueur à gages qui purge une peine de prison. En apprenant les meurtres et leurs détails, le prisonnier a soudain l'intuition d'une piste...

programme.title: SX Tape
programme.desc: Adam et Jill filment leurs ébats amoureux dans le cadre d'un vaste manoir désaffecté, autrefois un hôpital psychiatrique. Mais leur aventure érotique vire au cauchemar lorsqu'ils découvrent que le site est apparemment habité par des forces maléfiques.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Nomura, la trentaine, vit avec succès à Tokyo. Les filles l'aiment et il apprécie leur compagnie. Mais derrière cette apparence, personne ne se doute de la réelle identité de Nomura… C'est un criminel impitoyable et l'auteur de meurtres violents qu'il immortalise par des clips vidéo postés ensuite sur internet. À des milliers de kilomètres vit Bayu, un journaliste d'investigation en disgrâce parti vivre à Jakarta. Suite à d'innombrables échecs, Bayu commence à ressentir une fascination pour les vidéos de Nomura… Il crée alors un alter ego : celui d'un tueur en série justicier qui enregistre ses propres meurtres. Les deux tueurs vont alors se livrer à un face-à-face mortel…

programme.title: Kill list
programme.desc: Jay est un ancien militaire devenu tueur à gages. A contre-coeur et pour ne pas prendre en défaut son partenaire Gal, il accepte une dernière mission. Egalement accompagné de sa femme Shel, le voici parti pour accomplir son boulot : tuer à l'aveugle en échange d'argent... Il est des contrats avec le Diable qu'il ne vaut mieux pas signer !

programme.title: Mystery Road
programme.desc: Un détective indigène retourne dans l'Outback pour enquêter sur le meurtre d'une jeune fille.

programme.title: Déchaînés
programme.desc: Purgeant une peine de longue durée, Gary Tison est enfermé dans une prison isolée en Arizona. Il parvient à s'enfuire un après-midi de l'été 1978. Espérant trouver son salut au Mexique, il ignore qu'il est pourchassé par Cooper, shérif à la retraite.

programme.title: Sissy
programme.desc: Cecilia et Emma, meilleures amies d'enfance, se croisent après une décennie. Cecilia est invitée au week-end d'enterrement de vie de jeune fille d'Emma où elle se retrouve coincée dans une cabane avec son bully du lycée. Elle a un goût pour la vengeance.

programme.title: Money Plane
programme.desc: Un voleur professionnel s'attaque à un casino dissimulé dans un avion afin de régler une dette.

programme.title: Pandémie
programme.desc: Un groupe d'immigrants s'est introduit illégalement en Corée du Sud. Ils sont arrivés par bateau, tous entassés dans un container. Sans le savoir, l'un d'eux était porteur d'un virus...

programme.title: TOP10 BA
programme.desc: TOP10 BA - Les bandes annonces des meilleurs films : Comédies françaises: Redécouvrez les bandes annonces de vos films préférés : les plus drôles, les plus sombres, les Oscarisés, les Césarisés, tout y est !

programme.title: Faux raccords
programme.desc: Faux raccords - Les erreurs dans La petite sirène: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés ! Michel et Michel vous révèlent tous les secrets de vos films et séries préférés.

programme.desc: Aviez-vous remarqué - Les petits détails dans Dragon Ball Z (série): Redécouvrez les plus grands films et séries majeures avec un regard nouveau grâce à tous les petits détails que vous ne soupçonniez pas.

programme.title: Aviez-vous remarqué
programme.desc: Aviez-vous remarqué - Les petits détails dans Expendables: Redécouvrez les plus grands films et séries majeures avec un regard nouveau grâce à tous les petits détails que vous ne soupçonniez pas.

programme.title: Compile BA
programme.desc: Compile BA - Les bandes annonces des meilleurs films : Année 2016 Partie 1: Retrouvez toutes les bandes annonces de vos films et séries préférés regroupées par thème, genre ou encore par date de sortie.

programme.title: Allociné
programme.desc: Les dossiers Allociné - Bryan Cranston: Retrouvez tous les dossiers spéciaux pour tout savoir de vos films et séries préférés. Prenez le temps de rentrer dans les détails, dans le vif du sujet !

programme.title: Faux raccords
programme.desc: Faux raccords - Les erreurs dans La belle et la bête: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés ! Michel et Michel vous révèlent tous les secrets de vos films et séries préférés.

programme.title: Faux raccords
programme.desc: Faux raccords - Les erreurs dans le monde de Nemo: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés ! Michel et Michel vous révèlent tous les secrets de vos films et séries préférés.

programme.title: 5 choses étonnantes sur

Ali trouve alors un travail de serveuse au Burlesque Lounge, un théâtre musical majestueux mais en grande perte de vitesse.

programme.desc: Alors qu'elles visitent la Maison Blanche, Betsy et Arlene, deux adolescentes, tombent par hasard sur une pièce recelant les secrets du Président Nixon. Pour découvrir ce qu'elles savent vraiment, « Richard le truqueur » les nomme promeneuses de chien officielles. Soudain les filles se retrouvent impliquées dans la fameuse intrigue politique du Watergate. Alors que le duo plonge dans l'aventure, même les hommes du Président ne pourront les empêcher de changer le cours de l'histoire.

programme.desc: Emily T. Hope, adolescente mal dans sa peau, tente sans succes de retenir l'attention de son cher papa. Devant ses echecs repetes, elle tente le tout pour le tout et organise son propre kidnapping. Son plan reussit. En deguisant sa voix, elle previent son pere de l'endroit ou il peut la retrouver: dans le coffre de sa propre voiture. Mais Vincent Roche, voleur professionnel, vole le vehicule.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Riche, beau et célèbre, Jerry Maguire, agent des stars du sport americain, l'est. Mais sa vie mondaine et factice lui pèse, et une nuit il se remet en question dans une note qu'il rédige, où il tente de définir le sens qu'il voudrait donner à sa vie. Cette note va provoquer son licenciement et tous ses amis vont le trahir.

programme.title: Ideal Home
programme.desc: Erasmus et Paul, un couple gay, ont une vie festive et extravagante. Mais ce quotidien va être bouleversé lorsqu'un garçon de dix ans se présente à leur porte et prétend être le petit-fils d'Erasmus. Ni Paul, ni Erasmus, ne sont prêts à abandonner leur style de vie au profit de celui de parents.

Lorsque Maximo, le séducteur latin vieillissant, se fait plaquer par la femme d'âge mûr qu'il a épousée pour son argent, il emménage chez sa sœur Sara, à qui il ne parlait plus son fils de dix ans.

programme.title: Ma vie, mes règles

Son but : exposer l'arme de guerre biologique secrète du gouvernement, un virus mortel qui attaque instantanément le système surrénalien d'une personne, la poussant à devenir inhumainement agressive, avec une envie incontrôlable de s'entretuer.

programme.title: Dead Zone

En Afrique pour un reportage sur un joueur de football de sang royal, le Prince Otwani, Vic se trouve rapidement mêlé à un nid d'intrigues politiques.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel

programme.desc: A singer is challenged to record a Christmas album with a fallen star but ends up falling for him despite their endless arguments.

programme.title: Posh Pawn

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they'll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods' calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand's north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country's most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

programme.desc: “Project Tiger” is the largest and most ambitious conservation project in history. Its success is celebrated around the world, but until now the full story has remained hidden. Marking “Project Tiger's” 50th Anniversary this documentary offers intimate wildlife sequences with rare insight into the tigers' personal world and the ancient forests where they thrive, while unique access to never-before-seen undercover footage reveals the shocking truths of multi-national wildlife crime networks. Set against the backdrop of India's extraordinary growth and transformation, this incredible story is told in full for the first time by the people who have lived and breathed the traumas and the triumphs of five decades of tiger conservation in India.

programme.title: Indochina's Wild Heart
programme.desc: Indochina three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: Time Flies
programme.desc: We like to think we can control everything: changing the course of water, reclaiming land, replanting deserts – we constantly remodel the natural world to suit our needs. But there's one thing we can't control: the passing of time. However, we can change how we see things using cameras we can start to see the world in different time frames. Now we can see animals following the sun, mass movements of the changing seasons and even the vast impact of the changing weather. Watch what happens when time flies…

programme.title: Europe`s Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: For centuries, pilgrims have set off on the Via Francigena in the hopes of reaching the tombs of the apostles Peter and Paul in Rome. The ancient pilgrimage route leads through the imposing Alps to the Great St Bernard Pass and from there cross-country through Italy.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Amazing Isfahan
programme.sub-title: Paradise in the Heart of Iran
programme.desc: Take a look at this natural beauty. Isfahan – the Florence of Persia, the blue pearl of Iran. The city in the heart of Iran is the most charismatic city in the country and often uttered in the same breath as Bagdad, Constantinople or Cairo. The former capital of the Persian Safavid Empire has long since lost the status of cosmopolitan city, but it still radiates a cosmopolitan charm of which the inhabitants are extremely proud. With its Iranian and Persian national consciousness, Isfahan emits a form of comeliness that attracts people near and far. Following the 30-year-old carpet dealer Shanty as he tries to establish a business for himself and his fiancée Nina, we discover the soul of the city with mesmeric shots, intimate portraits and true to life portrayals of daily life. For 120 years his family has been dealing with noble Persian carpets, but Shanty dreams of a modern coffee shop, driven by a youthful eagerness to experiment and with passion for the new. In the cozy little espresso bar on the city's famous Imam Square Shanty's barista conjures up the best créma in Isfahan while Pink Floyd, The Grateful Death and Led Zeppelin boom from the loudspeakers nothing new in Berlin or Paris but almost revolutionary here. In intimate pictures, we accompany the youngest son of an old Isfahan family through his bulging everyday life and see how many young Iranians try to unite the culture and traditions of their country with the present.

programme.title: Food Unknown
programme.desc: Jonathan faces his toughest challenge yet as he enters a country that has been coming to grips in defining and understanding their own cuisine. Through the historical turmoil and harsh climate, Russia has lost it's traditional way of cooking, and eating. But the country is reviving this culture Jonathan ventures the far stretches of the country to learn about modern cooks, as well as ancient kitchens housing the one key tool that gave birth to true Russian cuisine, the Russian oven. He'll learn their insights, understand their efforts, and work with traditional Russian ingredients to learn what the cuisine used to be, and where it's headed today.

programme.title: Food Unknown
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is from California and he thinks he knows Mexican cuisine. This notion gets shattered as he experiences the onslaught of food in Mexico city! Between trying scorpion tacos and dodging shady markets in San Juan, he learns the dark art of sacred drinks, like pulque and mezcal, now turned into social libations. His journey also takes him to Oaxaca where he gets the low down on the fabled Mole sauce, and a long haul to a remote village reveals a secret ceremony that has origins of dark arts!

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space. Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm. Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members. Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal.

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way. NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album.

programme.title: NCT DREAM 'Beat It Up' MV
programme.desc: NCT DREAM's sixth mini album “Beat It Up” takes on the theme of 'the speed of time', sending a message that they're moving forward in their own pace and style. The title track “Beat It Up” hits hard with bold kicks, heavy bass, and a vibe that's all about breaking limits with confidence. The music video amps it up even more with a boxer concept, powerful moves, snappy cuts, and punch-heavy choreography that fires off the song's energy.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released. Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.” It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles, all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' MV
programme.desc: The lyrics reflect RIIZE's artistic vision, delivering the message that what they truly seek is not fame, but the sharing of emotions and love.RIIZE's second single “Fame” is the group's first venture into a rage-style hip-hop track, expressing their artistic ideals as “emotional pop artists.” The bold, forward-driving rhythmic structure combined with the raw texture of electric guitar creates a dynamic surge of energy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space. Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm. Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members. Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal.

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way. NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album.

programme.title: NCT DREAM 'Beat It Up' MV
programme.desc: NCT DREAM's sixth mini album “Beat It Up” takes on the theme of 'the speed of time', sending a message that they're moving forward in their own pace and style. The title track “Beat It Up” hits hard with bold kicks, heavy bass, and a vibe that's all about breaking limits with confidence. The music video amps it up even more with a boxer concept, powerful moves, snappy cuts, and punch-heavy choreography that fires off the song's energy.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released. Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.” It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles, all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' MV
programme.desc: The lyrics reflect RIIZE's artistic vision, delivering the message that what they truly seek is not fame, but the sharing of emotions and love.RIIZE's second single “Fame” is the group's first venture into a rage-style hip-hop track, expressing their artistic ideals as “emotional pop artists.” The bold, forward-driving rhythmic structure combined with the raw texture of electric guitar creates a dynamic surge of energy.

programme.title: SoundTrek Ep.1
programme.desc: Korea's first gugak band formed by foreign residents <Sound Trek> embarks on its very first journey. From every corner of the world, foreign souls gathered in Korea, united by the timeless sound of gugak. Dreams trebble like the strings of a gayaguem. Before the masters of gugak they compete. Who will be the next five to begin the legend of Sound Trek?

programme.title: SoundTrek Ep.2
programme.desc: Finally, the five members of Sound Trek have been selected! From accordion, flute, and Morin Khuur to djembe, and even a Mexican sorikkun (Korean traditional singer), they are now ready to write a new page of gugak. Their mentor, Kwon Songhee, former lead vocalist of the band Leenalchi, believes their potential, supporting every step of their way.

programme.title: SoundTrek Ep.3
programme.desc: Gugak still feels unfamiliar to the members. But they never gave up. Then one day, a gugak expert joins them for an arrangement collab. Sound Trek decides to reinterpret the famous minyo(folk song), “Sarangga” in their own unique style.

programme.title: SoundTrek Ep.4
programme.desc: With one-on-one coaching from their mentors and countless hours of repeated practice, their skills have now reached new heights. Then, an exciting piece of news arrives — Sound Trek has been invited to perform at the Uzbekistan National celebration, the homeland of Alex!

programme.title: SoundTrek Ep.5
programme.desc: SoundTrek arrived in Uzbekistan with butterflies in their stomachs and successfully completed their performance to the crowd's applause. They proved that music knows no boundaries, and that even non-Koreans can perform gugak if they have enough passion. Their journey, however, is far from over.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Har Har Bhakti
programme.desc: Listen to Har Har Bhakti Devotional songs and start your day with praise of gods and goddesses. These songs are composed to inspire reverence, devotion, and connection with the divine.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.
